text:
The provided evidence is a systematic review (registered in PROSPERO) synthesizing existing literature (74 included studies) to summarize contextual determinants associated with mental health care utilization in children and adolescents. 

In contrast, the candidate hypothesis describes an original empirical, observational cohort/cross-sectional study proposing specific primary data collection and analytical methods (geocoded provider density within 5 miles, a specific program intensity score, interaction terms in hierarchical linear regression, propensity score matching, and lagged analysis across the US, Canada, and the UK). The systematic review did not formulate or test this specific empirical candidate hypothesis.

VERDICT: REJECT
